before: strlen counts bytes, not Unicode characters. The UTF-8 literal é occupies two bytes. Encoding-aware operations need an encoding; byte slicing can split a multibyte character.

mb_strlen from the mbstring extension counts UTF-8 characters here and returns one. This is not universally the number of user-perceived grapheme clusters: combining sequences and emoji can contain several code points. This fixture requires mbstring instead of silently substituting a byte count.

extension_loaded("mbstring") receives an extension-name String and returns a Boolean indicating whether that extension is loaded in this process. The guard rejects an unavailable extension rather than changing the meaning of the length operation.
